seoTitle: Thread Splitter: Long Text into Numbered Posts
metaDescription: Split long text into numbered posts that fit X, Threads or Bluesky, breaking at sentence ends. Free, private, in your browser.
intro: Split a long text into numbered posts of a set length for X, Threads or Bluesky, breaking at sentence ends and keeping every post under the limit.
why:
Long ideas need a thread, but cutting one by hand is fiddly: each post needs room for its number and must not end mid-sentence.

Set the limit and the numbering style. The tool reserves space for the number, packs whole sentences into each post, keeps paragraph breaks where it can and splits only a sentence that is too long. With the X option, links count 23 and emoji 2. Links are never broken.
howTo: Set the limit per post and the numbering.
Keep the X counting option on for X.

faq.a: At sentence ends. A sentence longer than the limit is split at a word.
Space for 1/5 style numbers is reserved in each post.
